name: file_inspect
description: Inspect one file, saved project, or inline .cut document. Choose a half-open window for frame or packet queries. Starts a file job; poll file_job_status for its native CLI result. Supply the same operationID when retrying.

operationID.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct job. Identical requests can reuse it while running and for ten minutes after completion while local control stays enabled.

working_directory.description: Existing base directory for relative paths embedded in reports or project documents.

project.description: Absolute path to a saved project. Unsaved GUI changes are excluded.

from.description: Time in seconds, timecode, or exact rational seconds such as 1001/30000.
